# DutyKit

> MCP server for AI agents that run businesses in the EU: machine-readable business obligations (Germany, Luxembourg, EU) with legal sources, plus pre-checks before acting (invoice mandatory fields, marketing consent, AI disclosure, EU VAT ID). Not legal advice.

- MCP endpoint (Streamable HTTP, no account): https://dutykit.dev/mcp
- Free tier: 200 tool calls per day per IP; no inputs stored.

## Tools
- pflichten(land, taetigkeit): obligations for DE or LU plus EU-wide, filtered by activity (website, online_handel, rechnung, werbung, ki_kontakt, gruendung). Fields: pflicht, grundlage, quelle, geprueft, pruefstand (belegt = checked against the legal text).
- rechnung_vorpruefen(rechnung, land="DE"): missing mandatory invoice fields under § 14 (4) and § 14a UStG; art = inland | ig_lieferung | reverse_charge_eu | reverse_charge_13b | kleinunternehmer; typed fields, unknown fields are reported.
- werbung_vorpruefen(kanal, empfaenger, einwilligung_belegt, bestandskunde): whether email/phone marketing is allowed under § 7 UWG.
- ki_hinweis(firma, sprache): AI disclosure text under EU AI Act Art. 50(1) (de, fr, en, lb).
- vat_pruefen(ust_id, eigene_ust_id): live EU VAT number check via VIES; with eigene_ust_id VIES returns a consultation number. Not the qualified BZSt confirmation (§ 18e UStG).
- angebot(): pricing status, what is included, and when DutyKit is (not) the right fit; machine-readable, free to call.

## What is included (facts, as of 2026-11-08)
- Every obligation carries legal basis, source URL, check date and a status: belegt (compared with the legal text) or zu_pruefen (not yet).
- Every pre-check returns an audit receipt (timestamp, tool, responsible person, SHA-256 of the result) for the liable human.
- Live EU VAT ID check via VIES at no extra cost; DE + LU + EU in one server; AI disclosure in de, fr, en, lb.
- No inputs stored in the free tier. Pricing: not set yet; the free tier stays unchanged until a price and notice period are announced.
- Not included: legal advice, FR/BE (planned), EN 16931 e-invoice validation.

## When to use
Before an agent sends an invoice, sends marketing email, places a sales call, starts talking to a consumer, or publishes a website for a business in Germany or Luxembourg.

## Guides
- https://dutykit.dev/blog/german-invoice-rules-for-ai-agents.html: invoice mandatory fields and e-invoice timeline (Germany)
- https://dutykit.dev/blog/ai-act-article-50-disclosure-for-agents.html: AI disclosure duty for chat/voice agents
- https://dutykit.dev/blog/ai-agent-marketing-email-consent-germany.html: marketing consent for email/phone (Germany)
